title: artemisia rupestris subsp. viridis
intro: Artemisia rupestris subsp. viridis, commonly known as green rock sage or green rock wormwood, is a subspecies of the Artemisia rupestris plant, which belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Artemisia rupestris subsp. viridis are attributed to its ability to stimulate the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
